Accessible design is part of good design. Use this short sequence with logos, nameplates, slides, posters, labels, diagrams, interfaces, and fabricated objects.

{{< include ../../includes/generated/design-fabrication-accessible-design-toc.md >}}

The lessons paraphrase and reorganize the [Graphics Accommodation Guide](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AfDpLSJQtKy7YUMdwL8-BBR81NTv9Ck_cyzQ4pA2Hk4/edit). Source links and graphic descriptions are retained in the relevant lesson.
